text: In traditional palmistry the hand is sorted into one of four shapes named for the elements, by how broad the palm is and how long the fingers are. Books and websites differ on the details, so the names are one traditional scheme among several and not a measurement of the person.

shape: a square palm with shorter fingers
text: In traditional palmistry a square palm with shorter fingers is called an earth hand, which is linked with a practical, steady, hands-on temperament.

shape: a square palm with longer fingers
text: In traditional palmistry a square palm with longer fingers is called an air hand, which is linked with a curious, communicative, analytical temperament.

shape: a long palm with longer fingers
text: In traditional palmistry a long palm with longer fingers is called a water hand, which is linked with a sensitive, reflective, intuitive temperament.

shape: a long palm with shorter fingers
text: In traditional palmistry a long palm with shorter fingers is called a fire hand, which is linked with an energetic, spontaneous, enthusiastic temperament.
